slots.note: Full-length M.2 2280 NVMe; ships with a 2280 drive

ports.note: ASUS: 'Type C support USB 4 (Thunderbolt 4 compliance, DisplayPort 1.4 with Freesync support, Power Delivery 3.0)'. Not sold as a Thunderbolt port. pd_in_w is the bundled 65 W adapter rating.

screen.note: IPS-level, anti-glare low-reflection, 100% sRGB, 7 ms, AMD FreeSync Premium, Gorilla Glass Victus

battery.note: 80 Wh 4S1P 4-cell Li-ion. 65 W USB-C adapter (inclusion varies by region).

controls.stick_note: 2 x full-size analog sticks with light rings. Tom's Hardware: Hall effect sticks need a separate upgrade kit.
controls.note: ASUS: L & R Hall Effect analog triggers, 2 x assignable grip buttons, 6-axis IMU
